items.title: File Einspruch against the tax assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 27 Feb 2026, the earliest possible posting day. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a posted tax letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 27 Feb + 4 days = Tue 3 Mar 2026. Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month period starts 4 Mar 2026 and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the start day of the period, i.e. Fri 3 Apr 2026. Fri 3 Apr 2026 is Karfreitag (Good Friday), a public holiday in Hessen, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Tue 7 Apr 2026.

warnings: The Einspruch deadline of 2026-04-07 has already passed as of today (2026-09-26); if this deadline was missed, options such as Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand (reinstatement) would need to be checked with the Finanzamt or a tax advisor.
The letter states a refund of 550,00 € will be credited to the recipient's account but gives no date for this payment and no bank details to verify, so this cannot be treated as a firm deadline.
